translations.web: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
translations.bsb: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
translations.kjv: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
translations.asv: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
